verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms LM Studio can search/download and run a wide range of LLMs from Hugging Face (Llama, Qwen, gpt-oss, MLX models) via GUI or CLI, supporting broad architecture coverage, but the pack contains no explicit confirmation of embedding-model or multi-modal model support, so 'hundreds of architectures including MoE/multi-modal/embedding' is only partially substantiated.
